calibration: In-sample empirical resampling only; not a calibrated forward probability, not independent model-family evidence
convexity_buckets: all negatives -> bear; sorted positives split floor(50%), floor(90%) boundaries -> base/bull/moon; conditional means and empirical counts/N
limits: Shared retained data; stationarity and 21-session block choices assumed; no valuation or new validated edge.
Binary Kelly averages and four-bucket convexity compress dispersion; expected log growth is binary, not the full bootstrap distribution.
Illustration only: fractions, haircut, caps and baseline rates were not user chosen or approved.
Per-name capped references do not form a budget-feasible portfolio and do not replace existing $1000 targets.
Portfolio references are standalone unlevered sleeves; no borrowing, margin or account facts assumed.
Finite scenario asymmetry is not option gamma or open-ended optionality.
payoff_units: USD P&L on explicitly assumed standalone $1000 capital; return units remain decimal returns
resampling: 12 independently selected contiguous 21-session noncircular blocks; block start uniform 0..479 inclusive; common draws across seven streams
zeros: Count explicitly; refuse binary/four-bucket inputs if any exact-zero mass; never renormalize it away
